name: Anger Self Control
overview: Scripture reveals that self-control over anger is a mark of true strength and wisdom, as one who is slow to anger exercises greater power than the mighty and one who governs his spirit surpasses those who conquer cities. Prudence is demonstrated by deferring anger and showing grace in the face of transgression, which brings honor. The discipline to restrain speech and emotions protects the soul from trouble, while lack of self-mastery leaves a person vulnerable like a city without walls. Teaching and training in godly ways fosters lasting self-control, and wisdom is shown by holding back impulsive words rather than revealing all thoughts immediately.
